name: 23060 · Glen Allen, VA
findings: ZIP 23060 (Glen Allen) has 170 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23060 (Glen Allen) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23060 (Glen Allen) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
